_meta.description: Hulthen solver Coulomb/Born/unitarity limit verification (reviewer reviewV19_2_F §1)

verdict: Hulthen solver works correctly in the Born regime (alpha_D < 1e-3 at kappa=1) and shows expected unitarity saturation at kappa > 10^2. The framework-point result (5.3e-21 cm^2/g) is consistent with deep-Sommerfeld cancellation in the partial-wave sum at small alpha_D, where each phase shift delta_l ~ alpha_D * log(k/beta) is small but the (1-cos theta) transfer weight suppresses forward scattering.
